image_description: A close-up photograph of two unripe figs hanging from a branch against a background of large green fig leaves. The fig on the left is darker, showing purple and brown hues, while the fig on the right is predominantly green with some purple shading. Both fruits exhibit the characteristic pear shape with a narrow stem end and a broader base. The skin appears smooth with a matte finish. No cut cross-sections are visible.

To detect subtle texture anomalies in the skin of the figs or unnatural blurring in the depth of field.
To verify that the background leaves have consistent depth and do not show signs of geometric melting or spatial confusion with the foreground fruit.
